query: I am using our magento-based custom shopping website and I am on the "My Account" profile page. If I click the "View Order" link associated with one of the items on the page, I will be brought to the order's detail page. At the same time, what is the index, starting from one, of the active tab on the left column? What are the names of the active tab and all the tabs above it? Your final answer should be in English, for example one, two, three, followed by the tab names. Separate everything with commas and wrap your final answer in \boxed{}.

I am working with our ServiceNow portal. I am filling out the form to create a new problem record. If I change the "Impact" field to "Low" and the "Urgency" field to "Low", what value does the "Priority" field automatically change to?

I am using our magento-based shopping admin dashboard. After I open the page-builder editor while editing a product description, what two buttons are shown in the top-right toolbar? Your final answer should be a comma-separated list wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am working with our ServiceNow portal. When ordering a Dell XPS 13 from the Service Catalog, if I change the operating system from the default Ubuntu to Windows 8, what dollar amount appears in brackets next to Ubuntu?

I am working with our ServiceNow portal. In the Service Catalog, after submitting a Loaner Laptop order and reaching the Order Status page, what value is shown in the right-side Total box? Select ONE.

A. $0.00
B. empty
C. -
D. the full purchase price of the laptop
E. a calculated depreciation/decay value
F. the selected quantity multiplied by a unit rental price

I am working with our ServiceNow portal. When ordering a Dell XPS 13 from the Service Catalog, if I change the operating system from the default 250GB solid-state-drive (SSD) to 500GB, what dollar amount appears in brackets next to 250GB?

I am using our reddit-based custom forum website. On the Create submission page, does subscribing to a forum change anything in the bar under "Forum" and, if so, what changes? Your final answer should be wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am working in our ServiceNow portal on requesting an item for an employee. In the form, the internal stage value is set to waiting_for_approval. After submitting the form, what value does it translate to in the Approval column in the requested items list? Select ONE.

A. Requested
B. Pending Approval
C. Approved
D. Awaiting Approval
E. Approval Requested
F. Not Requested
G. No Approval Required
H. Not Yet Requested

I am using our magento-based custom shopping website and I am on the detail page of one of my previous orders. If I click the "Reorder" link, I will be brought to a new page. On that page, what are the names of the buttons visible below the item's thumbnail? Your final answer should be a comma-separated list wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am using our reddit-based custom forum website. I am on the page for creating a new forum. For the "Name" field, is it prepopulated with some prefix? If so, what is the prefix? If not, just say empty. Your final answer should be wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am working with our ServiceNow portal. When marking a problem as duplicate, a popup appears to collect additional information. Which field(s) are actually in that popup? Select ONE.

A. Duplicate of
B. Duplicate of; Resolution code
C. Duplicate of; Resolution code; Close notes
D. Duplicate of; Resolution code; Work notes / internal comments
E. Duplicate of; Resolution code; Customer-facing comments / additional information
F. Duplicate of; Resolution code; Parent
G. Duplicate of; Resolution code; Canonical problem; Notes
H. Duplicate of; Resolution code; Reason for marking as duplicate (short explanation)

I am using our reddit-based custom forum website. After I click the "Create forum" button, I am brought to the forum page, which is an empty forum without any posts yet. In the bottom-right corner, there is a Toolbox section. What is the second-to-last link in that section? Your final answer should be wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am working in our ServiceNow portal. When I am sorting inside the Catalog Items list, the full button label is "Show / Hide Filter." In our use case, the filter is currently hidden, so clicking it effectively shows the filter. Before selecting the target field, what is the default sort field shown in the sort row?

I am using our magento-based shopping admin dashboard. I am on the product listings page. In the Actions dropdown, what are the names of the batch action links that do not contain submenus? Your final answer should be a comma-separated list of names wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am using our magento-based shopping admin dashboard. Which option correctly combines one dashboard fact and one orders-grid fact from this environment?

A. The Most Viewed Products tab is placed between Customers and Bestsellers and the Orders grid includes a Braintree Transaction Source column.
B. The Most Viewed Products tab is placed between Customers and Bestsellers and the Orders grid does not include a Braintree Transaction Source column.
C. The New Customers tab is placed between Bestsellers and Most Viewed Products, and the Orders grid includes a Braintree Transaction Source column.
D. The New Customers tab is placed between Bestsellers and Most Viewed Products, and the Orders grid does not include a Braintree Transaction Source column.

I am using our reddit-based custom forum website. After I submit a post on a forum, I am brought to the page displaying the post. What is the sum of the upvotes and downvotes that this new post has? Your final answer should be in English (e.g., zero, one, two) and wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am working in our ServiceNow portal to balance workload across problems with the same tag. I reassign the lowest-priority problem from the user with the most assigned problems to the user with the fewest assigned problems. After filtering for that problem and opening it, what stage is the problem on, as shown in the progress bar at the top?

I am working with our ServiceNow service catalog and comparing the order pages for the `Standard Laptop` and the `Sales Laptop`. Which optional software choices appear on the `Sales Laptop` page but not on the `Standard Laptop` page? Give the two labels separated by semicolons in \boxed{}.

I am using our magento-based shopping admin dashboard. When I compare a completed order-detail page with a canceled order-detail page, how many top-toolbar action names are shared by both pages? Give your final answer as an English number followed by a comma-separated list of the shared actions, wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am using our magento-based custom shopping website. When I compare a category product-list page with a search-results page, which statement about the left sidebar filters is correct?

A. Both pages show both Category and Price.
B. Both pages show Category, but only the category product-list page shows Price.
C. Both pages show Price, but only the search-results page shows Category.
D. Neither page shows Category or Price.

I am using our magento-based shopping admin dashboard. Which statement correctly captures two navigation oddities in this environment?

A. The theme detail page has a second tab named Files below General, and the order-view left column has a Transactions tab before Shipments.
B. The theme detail page has no tab below General, and the order-view left column has no Transactions tab at all.
C. The theme detail page has a second tab named Content, and the order-view left column has Credit Memos between Transactions and Shipments.
D. The theme detail page has no tab below General, but the order-view left column still has Transactions before Shipments.

I am using our reddit-based custom forum website. I am on the home page of a forum. If I click the sorting-criteria dropdown, how many criteria are displayed, and what is the name of the second-to-last criterion? Your final answer should be an English number (e.g., one, two, three) followed by the criterion name, separated by a comma, and wrapped in \boxed{}.

I am working with our ServiceNow portal. I am filling out the form to create a new problem record. If I change the "Impact" field to "High" and the "Urgency" field to "Low", what value does the "Priority" field automatically change to?

I am using our magento-based shopping admin dashboard. When I cancel an order that originally has the state "pending", immediately after the cancellation action, what text is shown next to the order number inside the parentheses? Your final answer should be wrapped in \boxed{}.
